features.title: Capture eligible conversation and tool activity
features.summary: Persist eligible human, assistant, and tool activity with bounded redaction, replay deduplication, exclusion markers, and optional subagent capture.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; disable capture and memory use.
Boolean; capture eligible subagent activity.
Tool-name list whose input and output are excluded from capture.
Glob list applied before capture; sensitive defaults must remain excluded.

failureModes: Injected context and checkpoints are skipped.
Excluded tool/path content is represented only by a marker and never copied into memory.

verification.testName: stores user, assistant text, tool calls and results once, even when DSH re-delivers them
skips injected context (runtime, instructions, skills) and compaction checkpoints
maps a subagent to its own conversation linked to the parent, and can leave subagents out
keeps only a marker for excluded tools and for calls naming an excluded path, results included

features.title: Inject bounded same-project memory context
features.summary: Inject compact, bounded summaries into eligible prompts, refresh after configured growth, and fall back to compatible mode when a fork-only hook is unavailable.

configuration.constraints: One of compat or full; unsupported full-mode hook reports a compat fallback.
Integer from 1024 to 65536 bytes.
Integer from 512 to 65536 bytes.
Integer from 0 to 65536 bytes.
Override provider id; empty means the provider of the thread being summarized.
Override model for every summary; empty uses the thread's provider with its cheap model.
Empty (adapter default), low, medium, or high.

configuration.defaultValue: codex: gpt-6-luna (low); claude: claude-haiku-* (low); opencode-go: deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-flash, glm-5.3-flash; commandcode: deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-flash, gpt-6-luna; deepseek: deepseek-flash
configuration.constraints: Entries keyed by AI Accounts provider kind or exact provider id; models in preference order, a trailing * takes the newest match; each must be offered by the thread's provider.
Ordered provider/model/effort routes; empty provider means the thread's provider. With none offered, summaries wait and retry.
Integer from 1 to 16 concurrent tasks.
Integer from 1000 to 600000 milliseconds.
Integer from 0 to 60000 milliseconds.

failureModes: Unavailable summarizer leaves pending raw summaries for retry.
Cancellation preserves the durable barrier marker and does not inject stale context.
The stock Host cannot claim fork-only full mode is active.

externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject a synthetic gated summarizer and fake clock; routine tests never call a paid LLM or use account credentials.

verification.testName: stays in compatibility mode on stock DSH
reports full mode when the fork request-messages hook is present
sends system, instructions, the memory view and only the current turn, with a stable prefix inside a turn
renders events still waiting for a summary as pending lines after the barrier
rejects with the abort reason when the turn is cancelled during the barrier
leaves requests untouched without the fork hook
injects the compact project view without lines that only repeat the reading conversation
keeps the injected view within its budget once the project outgrows it
re-resolves a thread after the cache expires or the policy changes
sends a compaction call on the thread's resolved route with the input framed as data
fails clearly on an errored stream

features.title: Search and inspect scoped memory
features.summary: Expose bounded search, zoom, context, and status tools while keeping project scope isolated unless cross-project access is explicitly enabled.

configuration.constraints: Integer from 4096 to 1048576 bytes.
Integer from 2048 to 1048576 bytes.
Integer from 128 to 4096 bytes per node.
Integer from 1024 to 262144 bytes.
Boolean; permit cross-project reads only when opted in.

failureModes: A cross-project query is denied by default.
Database failure reports failed status while leaving the Host responsive.

verification.testName: recalls another conversation of the same project, then zooms and shows context
hides other projects unless all-projects retrieval is enabled
reports a disabled or missing memory as a clear tool error
never throws into DSH when the store breaks under it
degrades to a failed state when the database cannot be opened
survives a read-only memory directory

features.title: Edit memory settings and see live status in DSH
features.summary: One panel on the Settings nav and the bundle Plugins page edits every OptMem setting with row editors for cheap models and fallback routes, checks routes against the models each provider offers, shows live memory status, and pauses summaries or backfills sessions.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; while true no summary call is made and pending summaries retry once resumed.

failureModes: An old Host without the panel API shows a restart notice while settings still save.
An unregistered namespace shows defaults read-only.
Undecodable stored fields fall back to their defaults instead of failing the panel.

verification.testName: calls nothing while summaries are paused in settings, even with an override
fills every field an old Host does not serve with its default
keeps the valid fields when one stored field no longer decodes
writes only the fields that differ from the Host value
checks an override and fallbacks against the models their provider offers
flags a cheap-model entry none of whose models its providers offer

features.title: Explore one project's memory and pipeline
features.summary: The dedicated OptMem page offers project-scoped tree browsing, paginated search and source navigation, simulated context preview, and read-only persisted pipeline diagnostics.
failureModes: A missing project shows a choose-project state instead of loading forever.
Unavailable or stale nodes show a bounded error without touching the memory store.
Pending unsummarized leaves are accounted in Pipeline and are not represented as committed tree nodes.

verification.testName: resolves workspace and historical path identities and previews only the selected project
paginates project-scoped results without broadening the project filter
